Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1174
Claimant:
Alexander Murphy
Adjuster:
Darin Tyler
July 16, 2023
The claim was reported by the claimant after a side impact at an intersection. The driver is named on the policy, and
the coverage was in force at the time of the loss.
July 19, 2023
Police attended the scene and confirmed the claimant was in the vehicle that was struck. The claimant reported neck
and back pain at the scene.
August 11, 2023
I obtained the other driver's statement, which matches the claimant's description of the collision. The other driver
stated that the light had turned in the claimant's favor.
September 27, 2023
Witnesses who spoke with me gave accounts consistent with the claimant's version of how the accident happened.
Scene photographs were also reviewed and are in the file.
October 17, 2023
The damage to the claimant's vehicle is on the driver's side and lines up with the direction and force of the impact
described. No earlier damage to the vehicle is known from our records or the repair inspection.
November 5, 2023
I found nothing suggesting the damage occurred before the coverage start date. The vehicle's history was checked
and shows no prior claims on this area.
December 2, 2023
The claimant was seen at an urgent care facility the same day and was diagnosed with neck and back strain.
Treatment at that stage was consistent with the kind of force involved in a side impact.
December 4, 2023
I spoke with the claimant the following week, and the account of the accident was the same as in the first report. The
claimant has given the same description in every conversation since.
December 10, 2023
The claimant's treating provider requested authorization for physical therapy over several weeks. The course of care
was typical for this injury, and the number of visits tapered as the claimant improved.
December 13, 2023
Medical records were requested from the prior treating provider. These show long-standing treatment for the same
neck and back condition before this accident, and most of the current complaints appear to relate to that earlier
condition.
January 6, 2024
I discussed the prior records with the treating provider, who agreed that the current injury is a real strain from the
crash but that the ongoing symptoms are largely the pre-existing condition. The claim is being evaluated with that
distinction in mind.
January 10, 2024
The claimant is not represented by an attorney and has been informed of the coverage terms and the next steps. The
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
